goalText: Your goal is to quickly qualify leads and determine if they're a good fit for our premium enterprise solution. Focus on budget, authority, need, and timeline (BANT).

radarDimensions.label: Goal Clarity
radarDimensions.description: How well we understand the user's primary objective and what they want to achieve

radarDimensions.label: Decision Authority
radarDimensions.description: Does the user have authority to make purchasing decisions or influence them

radarDimensions.label: Budget Constraints
radarDimensions.description: Understanding of budget expectations and financial constraints

radarDimensions.label: Urgency & Timeline
radarDimensions.description: How urgent the need is and what timeline the user is working within

radarDimensions.label: Technical Context
radarDimensions.description: Understanding of the user's technical sophistication and existing infrastructure

checklist.label: Primary Goal
checklist.description: What is the user trying to accomplish? What problem are they trying to solve?

checklist.label: Company Size
checklist.description: How large is the organization? (focus on enterprise: 500+ employees)

checklist.label: Decision Authority
checklist.description: Are they a decision maker or influencer? Who else is involved?

checklist.label: Budget Awareness
checklist.description: What is the user's budget range? Are they authorized to spend $50k+?

checklist.label: Timeline
checklist.description: When does the user need a solution? Are they evaluating now or just researching?

checklist.label: Current Solution
checklist.description: What are they using today? Why are they looking for alternatives?
